seo-description-network: Network details and instructions to connect
networkLead: Add the Sintrop network to your wallet to interact directly with the protocol contracts.
connectLead: The apps connect through MetaMask. In the browser, with the MetaMask extension, you can add the network in one click; the mobile apps use MetaMask mobile.
metamaskGuideNote: A community guide on installing MetaMask, creating an account and connecting.
